title: Workflow authorization ticket
description: Umbrella authorization ticket recorded once at workflow run start. The executor consults it before dispatching each stage and pauses for re-authorization if cumulative settled + reserved + next-estimate would exceed authorizedCapacityUnits. Per-job settlement continues through the existing sogni-socket 'project + N identical jobs' path; the workflow layer is an authorization umbrella, not a new transaction ledger.

StageSettlement.description: Per-stage ledger row. estimatedUnits comes from the WorkflowCostPreview; settledUnits is filled in as the sogni-socket worker(s) for this stage finish.

projectId.description: sogni-socket project id. Null until dispatched.

jobIds.description: sogni-socket job ids. Empty until dispatched. May have multiple entries for fan-out stages.

settledUnits.description: Cumulative settled units for this stage. Null until at least one worker completes.

authorizedCapacityUnits.description: Umbrella cap. Per-job settlements stay within this; if next dispatch would exceed by more than the documented drift tolerance the run pauses for re-authorization.

expiresAt.description: Past expiry, the run pauses with cost_approval_required for re-authorization. Template declares an expected duration; expiry is duration + retry grace.

cumulativeReservedUnits.description: Estimated units for in-flight jobs not yet settled.

stageSettlements.description: Per-stage ledger. May be empty pre-dispatch; populated as the executor dispatches each stage.
